title: FintechBox FX Platform trade execution failing for amounts above 1 million USD
description: Traders are getting an error when trying to execute FX trades above 1 million USD through the FintechBox FX Platform. The error message is 'Trade amount exceeds configured limit'. Trades below 1 million execute normally. The limit was not intentionally set - this may be a default configuration value.

worklogs.description: Found trade amount limit in FX Platform risk parameters: max single trade = 1,000,000 USD.
This is the default value set during initial deployment. Customer's authorized limit should be 10,000,000 USD.
Updated max single trade limit to 10,000,000 USD with approval from customer's treasury operations manager.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I found the trade amount limit in the FX Platform risk parameter configuration: the maximum single trade amount is set to 1,000,000 USD. This is the default value from the initial deployment that was not customized for your operation. To change the limit, I need authorization from your treasury operations management. What is your intended maximum single trade amount, and who should authorize this change?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Our authorized maximum single trade is 10 million USD. Our treasury operations manager, Burak Yalcin, can authorize the change.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I have reached Burak Yalcin and received written authorization for the 10M USD limit. The FX Platform risk parameter has been updated. Please have a trader test a transaction above 1M USD.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Trader tested with a 2.5M USD EUR/TRY trade - executed successfully. The daily aggregate limit is also set at 10M by default - should that also be reviewed?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Good catch. The daily aggregate limit of 10M USD means that if you do a single 10M USD trade, no further trades are possible that day. Would you like me to get authorization to review and update the daily aggregate limit as well?

resolutionNote: Default FX Platform max single trade limit (1,000,000 USD) was never customized after deployment. Updated to 10,000,000 USD with written authorization from treasury operations manager.

csat.comment: Quick fix. Good that the daily aggregate limit was flagged too.
